title: Thanks **D*A**-Those splits of 'good stocks' have always
text:
Thanks **D*A**-Those splits of 'good stocks' have always grabbed my attention, hook, line, and sometimes a stinker!
Too bad my gut didn't have me triple up.
AAPL sits in the grands account, lucky them some day!
YES, that party was one to remember.
Tears were shed at some remarks by him and others.
Heartwarming
BUT, now Our Life has hit those bumps in the road again.
Both of us with complications=hospital admits.
At one point thought we might have to share a room!!
UGH!
HOWDY to ONE and ALL
As Mr. EZ says "Top o' the morning to all -
